{{Quote|Mandalore was slain recently and his killer, the new Mandalore, has taken his place. Whether or not he's another Imperial puppet remains to be seen but we must watch him closely.|Jedi Master [[Gnost-Dural]], on Mandalore the Vindicated|audio=ColdWarMandalore-Timeline4.flac|<ref name="TECS" />}}
'''Artus Lok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior of [[Clan Lok]] who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]], a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-wide conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Sometime after the signing of the [[Treaty of Coruscant]], [[Mandalore the Lesser|the reigning Mandalore]]&mdash;seeking to regain support after being defeated during the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]]&mdash;organized a competition for glory known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]], which was held on a galactic scale. Artus eventually became the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, and challenged the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] to a duel in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. He successfully [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Mandalorian leader and took the title of '''Mandalore the Vindicated'''. He began to consolidate his power over the Mandalorian clans, destroying an [[Crusader's schism|uprising]] led by [[Jicoln Cadera]], who believed the Mandalorians should support the Republic. After defeating Cadera's faction, Mandalore the Vindicated ensured that his Mandalorians remained allies of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].

==Biography==
Artus Lok, a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior who lived during the [[Great Galactic War]], which was a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Seven years prior to the [[Sacking of Coruscant]], [[Mandalore the Lesser|the reigning Mandalore]]&mdash;who was a puppet ruler secretly serving the Sith Empire&mdash;was [[Battle on the Hydian Way|defeated]] during the [[Blockade of the Hydian Way]]. After this, Mandalore organized a galaxy-wide competition for glory, known as the [[Great Hunt (competition)|Great Hunt]]. Artus fought during the [[Great Hunt (c. 3660 BBY)|competition]], eventually becoming the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt.<ref name="Bio" />

[[File:The_New_Mandalore2.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Mandalore the Vindicated, after having killed Mandalore the Lesser.]]
Artus challenged Mandalore to a duel<ref name="Bio" /> in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arenas on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]].<ref name="TECS" /> He [[Death/Legends|killed]] the Mandalorian leader and assumed the title of Mandalore the Vindicated. After defeating the Mandalore&mdash;who became known as Mandalore the Lesser&mdash;he began to consolidate his power over the Mandalorian clans. During this time, Mandalore defeated an [[Crusader's schism|uprising]] by a faction of Mandalorians led by [[Jicoln Cadera]], who believed that the Mandalorians should follow the ways of [[Canderous Ordo|Mandalore the Preserver]]<ref name="Bio" />&mdash;who fought during the [[Mandalorian Wars]] and the [[Jedi Civil War]] three centuries prior<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>&mdash;and support the Republic. After defeating Cadera's Mandalorians, Mandalore the Vindicated ensured that his Mandalorians remained well-paid, yet cautious, allies of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Bio" /> Under his leadership, the Mandalorians prospered. However, several of his contemporaries believed that their Mandalore was not content with being an ally of the Sith, and secretly harbored greater ambitions.<ref name="MandaloreCodex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Mandalore the Vindicated}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Artus summoned the latest [[Hunter (individual)|Grand Champion]] to his flagship, the ''[[Spirit of Vengeance]]''. He commended the Hunter for avenging [[Hedarr Soongh]], preventing the Great Hunt list from being leaked, and stopping [[Tarro Blood]]. He sent the Hunter to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] to kill a [[Sithspawn/Legends|Sithspawn]] and bring its heart as a trophy. Upon his Champion's successful return, Artus introduced the other Grand Champions, [[Bloodworthy]], [[Jewl'a Nightbringer]] and the [[Defenestrator]]. He declared the Hunter worthy of gaining access to the [[Blacklist]], a confidential list of impossible bounties reserved only to the Grand Champions.<ref name="TOR:THoD">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|The Heart of Darkness|the ''Spirit of Vengeance''}}</ref>

Artus then confessed that with war threatening to reignite, he wanted the Hunter to stand as his replacement among the Grand Champions, revealing that slaying the Sithspawn was a test. The Hunter gladly accepted his offer and became a Mandalorian.<ref name="TOR:THoD" />

When a Republic strike team sent by [[Jun Seros (Jedi)|Jun Seros]] [[Grand Champions massacre|assaulted]] the Grand Champions' party on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] to celebrate the Hunter's successful Blacklist kills, killing Bloodworthy, Jewl'a, and Defenestrator,<ref name="TOR:Notorious">{{TORcite|type=class|Bounty Hunter|Notorious|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> Artus sent a message to his surviving Champion, demanding that they avenge their fallen comrades upon the cowardly Republic scum.<ref name="TOR:Mtp">{{TORcite|type=message|Make them pay|Mandalore}}</ref>

Artus was later present on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] as part of the emergency war council gathered to discuss [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]].<ref name="SWTORAEB">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|An Empire Betrayed|Ilum}}</ref>

During the [[Eternal Empire]]'s Conquest, Mandalore summoned the clans to fight against the [[Eternal Empire]]. Mandalore the Vindicated was said to have died in a battle against the Eternal Empire, members of his clan saw him being swarmed by [[Skytrooper]]s.<ref name="TOR:TFoMtV">{{TORcite|exp=kotfe|type=codex|The Fall of Mandalore the Vindicated}}</ref> The manner of the Mandalore's death would later cause a grudge to form within the clans regarding droids.<ref name="TOR:TA">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|The Ash'ad}}</ref> [[Mandalore the Avenger|Shae Vizla]] reluctantly took on the mantle of Mandalore sometime after Artus' death.<ref name="KotFE 14" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:Drinks_with_Mandalore.png|thumb|250px|Mandalore the Vindicated was fond of the Mandalorian drink Ne'tra gal]]
{{Quote|I've got a lot to thank you for. Shoring that secret auction, avenging Hedarr Soongh, stopping that arrogant snob Tarro Blood.|Mandalore the Vindicated thanking the Great Hunt champion for their deeds.|<ref name="TOR:THoD" />}}
Mandalore the Vindicated, born Artus Lok, was a towering human male with dark skin and a shaven head, embodying both the physical prowess and the complex leadership qualities befitting a Mandalorian leader. His facial features were hardened, yet he lacked the gruffness often associated with his warrior kin, suggesting a leader who balanced sternness with approachability.

Artus was deeply respected and revered among the Mandalorian clans. His leadership was marked by a strategic mind and a vision that extended beyond mere conquest. This is evident in his cautious alliance with the Sith Empire; while he ensured his warriors were well-compensated allies, he remained vigilant and wary of the Sith's true intentions, reflecting his prudence and foresight.

His relationships were complex and multifaceted. Once a close friend to Jicoln Cadera, former chief of Clan Cadera, their bond fractured due to ideological differences after Artus claimed the title of Mandalore. Despite defeating Jicoln and vowing to eliminate his lineage, Artus refrained from harming Jicoln's son, [[Torian Cadera]]. Instead, he entrusted the Grand Champion of the Great Hunt with Torian's well-being during their travels, indicating possible regret and a lingering sense of duty towards his former friend's family.

Artus held strong opinions about the conduct of his warriors. He harbored a deep disdain for the bloodthirsty clan chieftain [[Mavrix Varad]], whom he described as a "rancor with a foaming mouth," highlighting his contempt for uncontrolled aggression. Furthermore, his dislike for the dishonorable Mandalorian Tarro Blood underscores his commitment to integrity and honor within the Mandalorian ranks.

In moments of camaraderie, Artus displayed a more personable side. He had a particular fondness for [[Black ale/Legends|Ne'tra gal]], a traditional Mandalorian black ale, often partaking in the drink, especially after adopting the Great Hunt champion into his clan. This appreciation for cultural traditions and his ability to enjoy the simpler pleasures amidst the burdens of leadership reveal a leader who remained connected to his roots and the customs of his people.

Mandalore the Vindicated was a leader of profound depth—strategic and cautious, yet capable of deep personal connections; a warrior who valued honor and discipline over reckless bloodshed; and a man who, despite the weight of his title, remained grounded in the traditions and relationships that defined the Mandalorian way.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:MandaloreTheVindicatedFull-TOR.jpg|thumb|200px|Mandalore the Vindicated]]
Mandalore the Vindicated first appeared in the video ''[[Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy]]'', which was released on the [http://www.swtor.com official website] of the [[Wikipedia:Personal computer|PC]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. He later received an entry in the "Biographies" section of the website's "Holonet" feature. On Mandalore's biographical entry, there are several phrases in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]. When translated, they read "Mandalore the Vindicated," "champion needed," and "Jedi merely first".

The Bounty Hunter player character in ''The Old Republic'' meets Mandalore onboard his cruiser, the ''Spirit of Vengeance'', at the beginning of Act II of their storyline. Mandalore calls on the Hunter, the newly-crowned Grand Champion of the Great Hunt, to slay "the Ghost in the Darkness" - a massive [[Terentatek/Legends|terentatek]] in the jungles of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]] - and bring back its heart as proof. Upon doing so, Mandalore offers to induct the Hunter into his clan and requests that the Hunter replace him on the [[Blacklist]], an exclusive group of hunters made up of other Grand Champions, in order to ensure that a Mandalorian remains among their number. With a Mandalorian taking his place, he explains, he can return to "winning the Sith's wars for them". Whether the Hunter chooses to join or not is up to the player.<ref name="TOR:THoD" />
